And after being delivered to Durham station in time for his five o’clock train, Jonesy’s journey was delayed and a mate had to be summoned from Cardiff to Bristol to save from him sleeping on the platform.
At the other end of our team, thanks to Jonesy indeed. He claims not to like grass, but there’s a cross-country runner in there just bursting to come out.
“Jonesy” was taking on Elliott Robinson, a redoubtable performer, but our man has raised his game exponentially in the last two years and he wasn’t about to let his reputation slip.
As the Newham and Notts runners went off, Neil took his place on the start line crouching almost like a sprinter … waiting for “Jonesy” to arrive … and then he was away.
